Panama is likely to adopt a 4-3-3 formation, which allows them to maintain defensive solidity while offering flexibility in attack. Under Christiansen, Panama has emphasized a disciplined defensive structure, relying on the central defensive partnership of Andrés Andrade and José Córdoba to provide stability. The full-backs, Amir Murillo and Omar Valencia, are expected to support the attack, offering width and crossing opportunities. In midfield, Aníbal Godoy's experience will be pivotal in orchestrating play and breaking up opposition attacks. The midfield trio will likely focus on maintaining possession and transitioning quickly to exploit spaces left by opponents. Offensively, Panama will look to utilize the pace and creativity of Rafael Mosquera and Azarias Londoño on the wings, with Eduardo Guerrero spearheading the attack. The team will aim to capitalize on set-pieces and counter-attacks, leveraging their physicality and speed.

The system relies heavily on the wing-backs for width and ball progression, with Amir Murillo on the right and Eric Davis on the left. In central midfield, captain Aníbal Godoy and Adalberto Carrasquilla will be expected to partner up.

results.title: Panama at the 2026 World Cup: Los Canaleros Squad, Key Players & Group L Guide | Fanorate
highlights:
Panama are the clear outsiders in Group L, ranked well below England and Croatia. The expanded 48-team format, where the four best third-placed teams advance, offers a slim but real lifeline. Their realistic target is the match against Ghana on June 17 in Toronto — likely the game that defines whether they can compete for a knockout spot.

Panama are the outsiders to qualify from Group L. Their season hinges on the opener against Ghana — a result there could keep alive hopes of a best-third-place finish in the expanded format. More likely, Panama will be competitive but fall short of the knockout rounds, with a maiden World Cup win or point representing genuine success. Projected: spirited group-stage campaign; a first-ever World Cup win is the realistic ambition, with knockout qualification a long shot.
